/tb3:
  amcl:
    ros__parameters:
      alpha1: 0.01
      alpha2: 0.01
      alpha3: 0.01

      alpha5: 0.01

      beam_skip_distance: 0.5

      beam_skip_threshold: 0.3

        y: -1.5
        yaw: 0.0

      laser_min_range: -1.0

      map_topic: /tb3/map

      max_particles: 2000
      min_particles: 500
      odom_frame_id: odom
      pf_err: 0.05
      pf_z: 0.99
      recovery_alpha_fast: 0.0
      recovery_alpha_slow: 0.0
      resample_interval: 1
      robot_model_type: nav2_amcl::DifferentialMotionModel
      save_pose_rate: 0.5
      scan_topic: /tb3/scan
      set_initial_pose: true
      sigma_hit: 0.2
      tf_broadcast: true
      transform_tolerance: 1.0
      update_min_a: 0.2
      update_min_d: 0.25
      use_sim_time: true
      z_hit: 0.5
      z_max: 0.05
      z_rand: 0.5

normal_smoother_parameter_files.raw:
/tb1:
  amcl:
    ros__parameters:
      alpha1: 0.01
      alpha2: 0.01
      alpha3: 0.01
      alpha4: 0.01
      alpha5: 0.01
      base_frame_id: base_footprint
      beam_skip_distance: 0.5
      beam_skip_error_threshold: 0.9
      beam_skip_threshold: 0.3
      do_beamskip: false
      global_frame_id: map
      initial_pose:
        x: 5.0
        y: 4.0
        yaw: 0.0
        z: 0.01
      lambda_short: 0.1
      laser_likelihood_max_dist: 2.0
      laser_max_range: 100.0
      laser_min_range: -1.0
      laser_model_type: likelihood_field
      map_topic: /tb1/map
      max_beams: 60
      max_particles: 2000
      min_particles: 500
      odom_frame_id: odom
      pf_err: 0.05
      pf_z: 0.99
      recovery_alpha_fast: 0.0
      recovery_alpha_slow: 0.0
      resample_interval: 1
      robot_model_type: nav2_amcl::DifferentialMotionModel
      save_pose_rate: 0.5
      scan_topic: /tb1/scan
      set_initial_pose: true
      sigma_hit: 0.2
      tf_broadcast: true
      transform_tolerance: 1.0
      update_min_a: 0.2
      update_min_d: 0.25
      use_sim_time: true
      z_hit: 0.5
      z_max: 0.05
      z_rand: 0.5
      z_short: 0.05
  amcl_map_client:
    ros__parameters:
      use_sim_time: true
  amcl_rclcpp_node:
    ros__parameters:
      use_sim_time: true
  behavior_server:
    ros__parameters:
      max_rotational_vel: 0.3
      min_rotational_vel: 0.15
      rotational_acc_lim: 1.0
      use_sim_time: true
  bt_navigator:
    ros__parameters:
      bt_loop_duration: 100
      default_server_timeout: 20
      global_frame: map
      navigate_through_poses:
        plugin: nav2_bt_navigator/NavigateThroughPosesNavigator
      navigate_to_pose:
        plugin: nav2_bt_navigator/NavigateToPoseNavigator
      navigators:
      - navigate_to_pose
      - navigate_through_poses
      odom_topic: /tb1/odom
      plugin_lib_names:
      - nav2_compute_path_to_pose_action_bt_node
      - nav2_compute_path_through_poses_action_bt_node
      - nav2_smooth_path_action_bt_node
      - nav2_follow_path_action_bt_node
      - nav2_spin_action_bt_node
      - nav2_wait_action_bt_node
      - nav2_assisted_teleop_action_bt_node
      - nav2_back_up_action_bt_node
      - nav2_drive_on_heading_bt_node
      - nav2_clear_costmap_service_bt_node
      - nav2_is_stuck_condition_bt_node
      - nav2_goal_reached_condition_bt_node
      - nav2_goal_updated_condition_bt_node
      - nav2_globally_updated_goal_condition_bt_node
      - nav2_is_path_valid_condition_bt_node
      - nav2_initial_pose_received_condition_bt_node
      - nav2_reinitialize_global_localization_service_bt_node
      - nav2_rate_controller_bt_node
      - nav2_distance_controller_bt_node
      - nav2_speed_controller_bt_node
      - nav2_truncate_path_action_bt_node
      - nav2_truncate_path_local_action_bt_node
      - nav2_goal_updater_node_bt_node
      - nav2_recovery_node_bt_node
      - nav2_pipeline_sequence_bt_node
      - nav2_round_robin_node_bt_node
      - nav2_transform_available_condition_bt_node
      - nav2_time_expired_condition_bt_node
      - nav2_path_expiring_timer_condition
      - nav2_distance_traveled_condition_bt_node
      - nav2_single_trigger_bt_node
      - nav2_goal_updated_controller_bt_node
      - nav2_is_battery_low_condition_bt_node
      - nav2_navigate_through_poses_action_bt_node
      - nav2_navigate_to_pose_action_bt_node
      - nav2_remove_passed_goals_action_bt_node
      - nav2_planner_selector_bt_node
      - nav2_controller_selector_bt_node
      - nav2_goal_checker_selector_bt_node
      - nav2_controller_cancel_bt_node
      - nav2_path_longer_on_approach_bt_node
      - nav2_wait_cancel_bt_node
      - nav2_spin_cancel_bt_node
      - nav2_back_up_cancel_bt_node
      - nav2_assisted_teleop_cancel_bt_node
      - nav2_drive_on_heading_cancel_bt_node
      - nav2_is_battery_charging_condition_bt_node
      robot_base_frame: base_footprint
      use_sim_time: true
      wait_for_service_timeout: 1000
  bt_navigator_rclcpp_node:
    ros__parameters:
      use_sim_time: true
  controller_server:
    ros__parameters:
      FollowPath:
        BaseObstacle.scale: 0.02
        GoalAlign.forward_point_distance: 0.1
        GoalAlign.scale: 24.0
        GoalDist.scale: 24.0
        PathAlign.forward_point_distance: 0.1
        PathAlign.scale: 32.0
        PathDist.scale: 32.0
        RotateToGoal.lookahead_time: -1.0

    ros__parameters:
      alpha1: 0.01

      pf_z: 0.99

      recovery_alpha_slow: 0.0

      scan_topic: /tb2/scan
      set_initial_pose: true
      sigma_hit: 0.2
      tf_broadcast: true
      transform_tolerance: 1.0
      update_min_a: 0.2
      update_min_d: 0.25

normal_smoother_parameter_files.raw:
/tb3:
  amcl:
    ros__parameters:
      alpha1: 0.01
      alpha2: 0.01
      alpha3: 0.01
      alpha4: 0.01
      alpha5: 0.01
      base_frame_id: base_footprint
      beam_skip_distance: 0.5
      beam_skip_error_threshold: 0.9
      beam_skip_threshold: 0.3
      do_beamskip: false
      global_frame_id: map
      initial_pose:
        x: 6.0
        y: -1.5
        yaw: 0.0
        z: 0.01
      lambda_short: 0.1
      laser_likelihood_max_dist: 2.0
      laser_max_range: 100.0
      laser_min_range: -1.0
      laser_model_type: likelihood_field
      map_topic: /tb3/map
      max_beams: 60
      max_particles: 2000
      min_particles: 500
      odom_frame_id: odom
      pf_err: 0.05
      pf_z: 0.99
      recovery_alpha_fast: 0.0
      recovery_alpha_slow: 0.0
      resample_interval: 1
      robot_model_type: nav2_amcl::DifferentialMotionModel
      save_pose_rate: 0.5
      scan_topic: /tb3/scan
      set_initial_pose: true
      sigma_hit: 0.2
      tf_broadcast: true
      transform_tolerance: 1.0
      update_min_a: 0.2
      update_min_d: 0.25
      use_sim_time: true
      z_hit: 0.5
      z_max: 0.05
      z_rand: 0.5
      z_short: 0.05
  amcl_map_client:
    ros__parameters:
      use_sim_time: true
  amcl_rclcpp_node:
    ros__parameters:
      use_sim_time: true
  behavior_server:
    ros__parameters:
      max_rotational_vel: 0.3
      min_rotational_vel: 0.15
      rotational_acc_lim: 1.0
      use_sim_time: true
  bt_navigator:
    ros__parameters:
      bt_loop_duration: 100
      default_server_timeout: 20
      global_frame: map
      navigate_through_poses:
        plugin: nav2_bt_navigator/NavigateThroughPosesNavigator
      navigate_to_pose:
        plugin: nav2_bt_navigator/NavigateToPoseNavigator
      navigators:
      - navigate_to_pose
      - navigate_through_poses
      odom_topic: /tb3/odom
      plugin_lib_names:
      - nav2_compute_path_to_pose_action_bt_node
      - nav2_compute_path_through_poses_action_bt_node
      - nav2_smooth_path_action_bt_node
      - nav2_follow_path_action_bt_node
      - nav2_spin_action_bt_node
      - nav2_wait_action_bt_node
      - nav2_assisted_teleop_action_bt_node
      - nav2_back_up_action_bt_node
      - nav2_drive_on_heading_bt_node
      - nav2_clear_costmap_service_bt_node
      - nav2_is_stuck_condition_bt_node
      - nav2_goal_reached_condition_bt_node
      - nav2_goal_updated_condition_bt_node
      - nav2_globally_updated_goal_condition_bt_node
      - nav2_is_path_valid_condition_bt_node
      - nav2_initial_pose_received_condition_bt_node
      - nav2_reinitialize_global_localization_service_bt_node
      - nav2_rate_controller_bt_node
      - nav2_distance_controller_bt_node
      - nav2_speed_controller_bt_node
      - nav2_truncate_path_action_bt_node
      - nav2_truncate_path_local_action_bt_node
      - nav2_goal_updater_node_bt_node
      - nav2_recovery_node_bt_node
      - nav2_pipeline_sequence_bt_node
      - nav2_round_robin_node_bt_node
      - nav2_transform_available_condition_bt_node

normal_smoother_parameter_files.raw:
/tb1:
  amcl:
    ros__parameters:
      alpha1: 0.01
      alpha2: 0.01
      alpha3: 0.01
      alpha4: 0.01
      alpha5: 0.01
      base_frame_id: base_footprint
      beam_skip_distance: 0.5
      beam_skip_error_threshold: 0.9
      beam_skip_threshold: 0.3
      do_beamskip: false
      global_frame_id: map
      initial_pose:
        x: 5.0
        y: 4.0
        yaw: 0.0
        z: 0.01
      lambda_short: 0.1
      laser_likelihood_max_dist: 2.0
      laser_max_range: 100.0
      laser_min_range: -1.0
      laser_model_type: likelihood_field
      map_topic: /tb1/map
      max_beams: 60
      max_particles: 2000
      min_particles: 500
      odom_frame_id: odom
      pf_err: 0.05
      pf_z: 0.99
      recovery_alpha_fast: 0.0
      recovery_alpha_slow: 0.0
      resample_interval: 1
      robot_model_type: nav2_amcl::DifferentialMotionModel
      save_pose_rate: 0.5
      scan_topic: /tb1/scan
      set_initial_pose: true
      sigma_hit: 0.2
      tf_broadcast: true
      transform_tolerance: 1.0
      update_min_a: 0.2
      update_min_d: 0.25
      use_sim_time: true
      z_hit: 0.5
      z_max: 0.05
      z_rand: 0.5
      z_short: 0.05
  amcl_map_client:
    ros__parameters:
      use_sim_time: true
  amcl_rclcpp_node:
    ros__parameters:
      use_sim_time: true
  behavior_server:
    ros__parameters:
      max_rotational_vel: 0.3
      min_rotational_vel: 0.15
      rotational_acc_lim: 1.0
      use_sim_time: true
  bt_navigator:
    ros__parameters:
      bt_loop_duration: 100
      default_server_timeout: 20
      global_frame: map
      navigate_through_poses:
        plugin: nav2_bt_navigator/NavigateThroughPosesNavigator
      navigate_to_pose:
        plugin: nav2_bt_navigator/NavigateToPoseNavigator
      navigators:
      - navigate_to_pose
      - navigate_through_poses
      odom_topic: /tb1/odom
      plugin_lib_names:
      - nav2_compute_path_to_pose_action_bt_node
      - nav2_compute_path_through_poses_action_bt_node
      - nav2_smooth_path_action_bt_node
      - nav2_follow_path_action_bt_node
      - nav2_spin_action_bt_node
      - nav2_wait_action_bt_node
      - nav2_assisted_teleop_action_bt_node
      - nav2_back_up_action_bt_node
      - nav2_drive_on_heading_bt_node
      - nav2_clear_costmap_service_bt_node
      - nav2_is_stuck_condition_bt_node
      - nav2_goal_reached_condition_bt_node
      - nav2_goal_updated_condition_bt_node
      - nav2_globally_updated_goal_condition_bt_node
      - nav2_is_path_valid_condition_bt_node
      - nav2_initial_pose_received_condition_bt_node
      - nav2_reinitialize_global_localization_service_bt_node
      - nav2_rate_controller_bt_node
      - nav2_distance_controller_bt_node
      - nav2_speed_controller_bt_node
      - nav2_truncate_path_action_bt_node
      - nav2_truncate_path_local_action_bt_node
      - nav2_goal_updater_node_bt_node
      - nav2_recovery_node_bt_node
      - nav2_pipeline_sequence_bt_node
      - nav2_round_robin_node_bt_node
      - nav2_transform_available_condition_bt_node
      - nav2_time_expired_condition_bt_node
      - nav2_path_expiring_timer_condition
      - nav2_distance_traveled_condition_bt_node
      - nav2_single_trigger_bt_node
      - nav2_goal_updated_controller_bt_node
      - nav2_is_battery_low_condition_bt_node
      - nav2_navigate_through_poses_action_bt_node
      - nav2_navigate_to_pose_action_bt_node
      - nav2_remove_passed_goals_action_bt_node
      - nav2_planner_selector_bt_node
      - nav2_controller_selector_bt_node
      - nav2_goal_checker_selector_bt_node
      - nav2_controller_cancel_bt_node
      - nav2_path_longer_on_approach_bt_node
      - nav2_wait_cancel_bt_node
      - nav2_spin_cancel_bt_node
      - nav2_back_up_cancel_bt_node
      - nav2_assisted_teleop_cancel_bt_node
      - nav2_drive_on_heading_cancel_bt_node
      - nav2_is_battery_charging_condition_bt_node
      robot_base_frame: base_footprint
      use_sim_time: true
      wait_for_service_timeout: 1000
  bt_navigator_rclcpp_node:
    ros__parameters:
      use_sim_time: true
  controller_server:
    ros__parameters:
      FollowPath:
        BaseObstacle.scale: 0.02
        GoalAlign.forward_point_distance: 0.1
        GoalAlign.scale: 24.0
        GoalDist.scale: 24.0
        PathAlign.forward_point_distance: 0.1
        PathAlign.scale: 32.0
        PathDist.scale: 32.0
        RotateToGoal.lookahead_time: -1.0
        RotateToGoal.scale: 32.0
        RotateToGoal.slowing_factor: 5.0
        acc_lim_theta: 1.0
        acc_lim_x: 0.5
        acc_lim_y: 0.0
        angular_disengage_threshold: 0.5
        angular_dist_threshold: 0.5
        angular_granularity: 0.025
        closed_loop: true
        critics:

normal_smoother_parameter_files.raw:
/tb2:
  amcl:
    ros__parameters:
      alpha1: 0.01
      alpha2: 0.01
      alpha3: 0.01
      alpha4: 0.01
      alpha5: 0.01
      base_frame_id: base_footprint
      beam_skip_distance: 0.5
      beam_skip_error_threshold: 0.9
      beam_skip_threshold: 0.3
      do_beamskip: false
      global_frame_id: map
      initial_pose:
        x: -4.5
        y: 4.0
        yaw: 0.0
        z: 0.01
      lambda_short: 0.1
      laser_likelihood_max_dist: 2.0
      laser_max_range: 100.0
      laser_min_range: -1.0
      laser_model_type: likelihood_field
      map_topic: /tb2/map
      max_beams: 60
      max_particles: 2000
      min_particles: 500
      odom_frame_id: odom
      pf_err: 0.05
      pf_z: 0.99
      recovery_alpha_fast: 0.0
      recovery_alpha_slow: 0.0
      resample_interval: 1
      robot_model_type: nav2_amcl::DifferentialMotionModel
      save_pose_rate: 0.5
      scan_topic: /tb2/scan
      set_initial_pose: true
      sigma_hit: 0.2
      tf_broadcast: true
      transform_tolerance: 1.0
      update_min_a: 0.2
      update_min_d: 0.25
      use_sim_time: true
      z_hit: 0.5
      z_max: 0.05
      z_rand: 0.5
      z_short: 0.05
  amcl_map_client:
    ros__parameters:
      use_sim_time: true
  amcl_rclcpp_node:
    ros__parameters:
      use_sim_time: true
  behavior_server:
    ros__parameters:
      max_rotational_vel: 0.3
      min_rotational_vel: 0.15
      rotational_acc_lim: 1.0
      use_sim_time: true
  bt_navigator:
    ros__parameters:
      bt_loop_duration: 100
      default_server_timeout: 20
      global_frame: map
      navigate_through_poses:
        plugin: nav2_bt_navigator/NavigateThroughPosesNavigator
      navigate_to_pose:
        plugin: nav2_bt_navigator/NavigateToPoseNavigator
      navigators:
      - navigate_to_pose
      - navigate_through_poses
      odom_topic: /tb2/odom
      plugin_lib_names:
      - nav2_compute_path_to_pose_action_bt_node
      - nav2_compute_path_through_poses_action_bt_node
      - nav2_smooth_path_action_bt_node
      - nav2_follow_path_action_bt_node
      - nav2_spin_action_bt_node
      - nav2_wait_action_bt_node
      - nav2_assisted_teleop_action_bt_node
      - nav2_back_up_action_bt_node
      - nav2_drive_on_heading_bt_node
      - nav2_clear_costmap_service_bt_node
      - nav2_is_stuck_condition_bt_node
      - nav2_goal_reached_condition_bt_node
      - nav2_goal_updated_condition_bt_node
      - nav2_globally_updated_goal_condition_bt_node
      - nav2_is_path_valid_condition_bt_node
      - nav2_initial_pose_received_condition_bt_node
      - nav2_reinitialize_global_localization_service_bt_node
      - nav2_rate_controller_bt_node
      - nav2_distance_controller_bt_node
      - nav2_speed_controller_bt_node
      - nav2_truncate_path_action_bt_node
      - nav2_truncate_path_local_action_bt_node
      - nav2_goal_updater_node_bt_node
      - nav2_recovery_node_bt_node
      - nav2_pipeline_sequence_bt_node
      - nav2_round_robin_node_bt_node
      - nav2_transform_available_condition_bt_node
      - nav2_time_expired_condition_bt_node
      - nav2_path_expiring_timer_condition
      - nav2_distance_traveled_condition_bt_node
      - nav2_single_trigger_bt_node
      - nav2_goal_updated_controller_bt_node
      - nav2_is_battery_low_condition_bt_node
      - nav2_navigate_through_poses_action_bt_node
      - nav2_navigate_to_pose_action_bt_node
      - nav2_remove_passed_goals_action_bt_node
      - nav2_planner_selector_bt_node
      - nav2_controller_selector_bt_node
      - nav2_goal_checker_selector_bt_node
      - nav2_controller_cancel_bt_node
      - nav2_path_longer_on_approach_bt_node
      - nav2_wait_cancel_bt_node
      - nav2_spin_cancel_bt_node
      - nav2_back_up_cancel_bt_node
      - nav2_assisted_teleop_cancel_bt_node
      - nav2_drive_on_heading_cancel_bt_node
      - nav2_is_battery_charging_condition_bt_node
      robot_base_frame: base_footprint
      use_sim_time: true
      wait_for_service_timeout: 1000
  bt_navigator_rclcpp_node:
    ros__parameters:
      use_sim_time: true
  controller_server:
    ros__parameters:
      FollowPath:
        BaseObstacle.scale: 0.02
        GoalAlign.forward_point_distance: 0.1
        GoalAlign.scale: 24.0
        GoalDist.scale: 24.0
        PathAlign.forward_point_distance: 0.1
        PathAlign.scale: 32.0
        PathDist.scale: 32.0
        RotateToGoal.lookahead_time: -1.0
        RotateToGoal.scale: 32.0
        RotateToGoal.slowing_factor: 5.0
        acc_lim_theta: 1.0
        acc_lim_x: 0.5
        acc_lim_y: 0.0
        angular_disengage_threshold: 0.5
        angular_dist_threshold: 0.5
        angular_granularity: 0.025
        closed_loop: true
        critics:
        - RotateToGoal
        - Oscillation
        - BaseObstacle
        - GoalAlign
        - PathAlign

/tb3:
  amcl:
    ros__parameters:
      alpha1: 0.01
      alpha2: 0.01
      alpha3: 0.01
      alpha4: 0.01
      alpha5: 0.01
      base_frame_id: base_footprint
      beam_skip_distance: 0.5
      beam_skip_error_threshold: 0.9
      beam_skip_threshold: 0.3
      do_beamskip: false
      global_frame_id: map
      initial_pose:
        x: 6.0
        y: -1.5
        yaw: 0.0
        z: 0.01
      lambda_short: 0.1
      laser_likelihood_max_dist: 2.0
      laser_max_range: 100.0
      laser_min_range: -1.0
      laser_model_type: likelihood_field
      map_topic: /tb3/map
      max_beams: 60
      max_particles: 2000
      min_particles: 500
      odom_frame_id: odom
      pf_err: 0.05
      pf_z: 0.99
      recovery_alpha_fast: 0.0
      recovery_alpha_slow: 0.0
      resample_interval: 1
      robot_model_type: nav2_amcl::DifferentialMotionModel
      save_pose_rate: 0.5
      scan_topic: /tb3/scan
      set_initial_pose: true
      sigma_hit: 0.2
      tf_broadcast: true
      transform_tolerance: 1.0
      update_min_a: 0.2
      update_min_d: 0.25
      use_sim_time: true
      z_hit: 0.5
      z_max: 0.05
      z_rand: 0.5
      z_short: 0.05
  amcl_map_client:
    ros__parameters:
      use_sim_time: true
  amcl_rclcpp_node:
    ros__parameters:
      use_sim_time: true
  behavior_server:
    ros__parameters:
      max_rotational_vel: 0.3
      min_rotational_vel: 0.15
      rotational_acc_lim: 1.0
      use_sim_time: true

      navigators:
      - navigate_to_pose

      - nav2_speed_controller_bt_node
      - nav2_truncate_path_action_bt_node
      - nav2_truncate_path_local_action_bt_node
      - nav2_goal_updater_node_bt_node
      - nav2_recovery_node_bt_node
      - nav2_pipeline_sequence_bt_node
      - nav2_round_robin_node_bt_node

      - nav2_single_trigger_bt_node

      - nav2_navigate_through_poses_action_bt_node

      robot_base_frame: base_footprint
      use_sim_time: true
      wait_for_service_timeout: 1000

    ros__parameters:
      use_sim_time: true

    ros__parameters:

/tb1:
  amcl:
    ros__parameters:
      alpha1: 0.01
      alpha2: 0.01
      alpha3: 0.01
      alpha4: 0.01
      alpha5: 0.01
      base_frame_id: base_footprint
      beam_skip_distance: 0.5
      beam_skip_error_threshold: 0.9
      beam_skip_threshold: 0.3
      do_beamskip: false
      global_frame_id: map
      initial_pose:
        x: 5.0
        y: 4.0
        yaw: 0.0
        z: 0.01
      lambda_short: 0.1
      laser_likelihood_max_dist: 2.0
      laser_max_range: 100.0
      laser_min_range: -1.0
      laser_model_type: likelihood_field
      map_topic: /tb1/map
      max_beams: 60
      max_particles: 2000
      min_particles: 500
      odom_frame_id: odom
      pf_err: 0.05
      pf_z: 0.99
      recovery_alpha_fast: 0.0
      recovery_alpha_slow: 0.0
      resample_interval: 1
      robot_model_type: nav2_amcl::DifferentialMotionModel
      save_pose_rate: 0.5
      scan_topic: /tb1/scan
      set_initial_pose: true
      sigma_hit: 0.2
      tf_broadcast: true
      transform_tolerance: 1.0
      update_min_a: 0.2
      update_min_d: 0.25
      use_sim_time: true
      z_hit: 0.5
      z_max: 0.05
      z_rand: 0.5
      z_short: 0.05
  amcl_map_client:
    ros__parameters:
      use_sim_time: true
  amcl_rclcpp_node:
    ros__parameters:
      use_sim_time: true
  behavior_server:
    ros__parameters:
      max_rotational_vel: 0.3
      min_rotational_vel: 0.15
      rotational_acc_lim: 1.0
      use_sim_time: true

      default_server_timeout: 20

        plugin: nav2_bt_navigator/NavigateThroughPosesNavigator
      navigate_to_pose:
        plugin: nav2_bt_navigator/NavigateToPoseNavigator
      navigators:
      - navigate_to_pose

      - nav2_speed_controller_bt_node
      - nav2_truncate_path_action_bt_node

      - nav2_recovery_node_bt_node

      - nav2_round_robin_node_bt_node
      - nav2_transform_available_condition_bt_node

      - nav2_single_trigger_bt_node

      - nav2_navigate_through_poses_action_bt_node

      - nav2_is_battery_charging_condition_bt_node
      robot_base_frame: base_footprint
      use_sim_time: true
      wait_for_service_timeout: 1000

    ros__parameters:
      use_sim_time: true

    ros__parameters:

        GoalAlign.scale: 24.0
        GoalDist.scale: 24.0
        PathAlign.forward_point_distance: 0.1
        PathAlign.scale: 32.0
        PathDist.scale: 32.0

        RotateToGoal.scale: 32.0
        RotateToGoal.slowing_factor: 5.0

        acc_lim_y: 0.0
        angular_disengage_threshold: 0.5
        angular_dist_threshold: 0.5
        angular_granularity: 0.025
        closed_loop: true

        - GoalAlign

        - PathDist

        decel_lim_x: -0.5

        forward_sampling_distance: 0.3
        linear_granularity: 0.05

        min_speed_theta: 0.0

normal_smoother_parameter_files.raw:
/tb1:
  amcl:
    ros__parameters:
      alpha1: 0.01
      alpha2: 0.01
      alpha3: 0.01
      alpha4: 0.01
      alpha5: 0.01
      base_frame_id: base_footprint
      beam_skip_distance: 0.5
      beam_skip_error_threshold: 0.9
      beam_skip_threshold: 0.3
      do_beamskip: false
      global_frame_id: map
      initial_pose:
        x: 5.0
        y: 4.0
        yaw: 0.0
        z: 0.01
      lambda_short: 0.1
      laser_likelihood_max_dist: 2.0
      laser_max_range: 100.0
      laser_min_range: -1.0
      laser_model_type: likelihood_field
      map_topic: /tb1/map
      max_beams: 60
      max_particles: 2000
      min_particles: 500
      odom_frame_id: odom
      pf_err: 0.05
      pf_z: 0.99
      recovery_alpha_fast: 0.0
      recovery_alpha_slow: 0.0
      resample_interval: 1
      robot_model_type: nav2_amcl::DifferentialMotionModel
      save_pose_rate: 0.5
      scan_topic: /tb1/scan
      set_initial_pose: true
      sigma_hit: 0.2
      tf_broadcast: true
      transform_tolerance: 1.0
      update_min_a: 0.2
      update_min_d: 0.25
      use_sim_time: true
      z_hit: 0.5
      z_max: 0.05
      z_rand: 0.5
      z_short: 0.05
  amcl_map_client:
    ros__parameters:
      use_sim_time: true
  amcl_rclcpp_node:
    ros__parameters:
      use_sim_time: true
  behavior_server:
    ros__parameters:
      max_rotational_vel: 0.3
      min_rotational_vel: 0.15
      rotational_acc_lim: 1.0
      use_sim_time: true
  bt_navigator:
    ros__parameters:
      bt_loop_duration: 100
      default_server_timeout: 20
      global_frame: map
      navigate_through_poses:
        plugin: nav2_bt_navigator/NavigateThroughPosesNavigator
      navigate_to_pose:
        plugin: nav2_bt_navigator/NavigateToPoseNavigator
      navigators:
      - navigate_to_pose
      - navigate_through_poses
      odom_topic: /tb1/odom
      plugin_lib_names:
      - nav2_compute_path_to_pose_action_bt_node
      - nav2_compute_path_through_poses_action_bt_node
      - nav2_smooth_path_action_bt_node
      - nav2_follow_path_action_bt_node
      - nav2_spin_action_bt_node
      - nav2_wait_action_bt_node
      - nav2_assisted_teleop_action_bt_node
      - nav2_back_up_action_bt_node
      - nav2_drive_on_heading_bt_node
      - nav2_clear_costmap_service_bt_node
      - nav2_is_stuck_condition_bt_node
      - nav2_goal_reached_condition_bt_node
      - nav2_goal_updated_condition_bt_node
      - nav2_globally_updated_goal_condition_bt_node
      - nav2_is_path_valid_condition_bt_node
      - nav2_initial_pose_received_condition_bt_node
      - nav2_reinitialize_global_localization_service_bt_node
      - nav2_rate_controller_bt_node
      - nav2_distance_controller_bt_node
      - nav2_speed_controller_bt_node
      - nav2_truncate_path_action_bt_node
      - nav2_truncate_path_local_action_bt_node
      - nav2_goal_updater_node_bt_node
      - nav2_recovery_node_bt_node
      - nav2_pipeline_sequence_bt_node
      - nav2_round_robin_node_bt_node
      - nav2_transform_available_condition_bt_node
      - nav2_time_expired_condition_bt_node
      - nav2_path_expiring_timer_condition
      - nav2_distance_traveled_condition_bt_node
      - nav2_single_trigger_bt_node
      - nav2_goal_updated_controller_bt_node
      - nav2_is_battery_low_condition_bt_node
      - nav2_navigate_through_poses_action_bt_node
      - nav2_navigate_to_pose_action_bt_node
      - nav2_remove_passed_goals_action_bt_node
      - nav2_planner_selector_bt_node
      - nav2_controller_selector_bt_node
      - nav2_goal_checker_selector_bt_node
      - nav2_controller_cancel_bt_node
      - nav2_path_longer_on_approach_bt_node
      - nav2_wait_cancel_bt_node
      - nav2_spin_cancel_bt_node
      - nav2_back_up_cancel_bt_node
      - nav2_assisted_teleop_cancel_bt_node
      - nav2_drive_on_heading_cancel_bt_node
      - nav2_is_battery_charging_condition_bt_node
      robot_base_frame: base_footprint
      use_sim_time: true
      wait_for_service_timeout: 1000
  bt_navigator_rclcpp_node:
    ros__parameters:
      use_sim_time: true
  controller_server:
    ros__parameters:
      FollowPath:
        BaseObstacle.scale: 0.02
        GoalAlign.forward_point_distance: 0.1
        GoalAlign.scale: 24.0
        GoalDist.scale: 24.0
        PathAlign.forward_point_distance: 0.1
        PathAlign.scale: 32.0
        PathDist.scale: 32.0
        RotateToGoal.lookahead_time: -1.0
        RotateToGoal.scale: 32.0
        RotateToGoal.slowing_factor: 5.0
        acc_lim_theta: 1.0
        acc_lim_x: 0.5
        acc_lim_y: 0.0
        angular_disengage_threshold: 0.5
        angular_dist_threshold: 0.5
        angular_granularity: 0.025

/tb2:

    ros__parameters:
      alpha1: 0.01

      alpha5: 0.01

      pf_z: 0.99

      recovery_alpha_slow: 0.0

      scan_topic: /tb2/scan
      set_initial_pose: true
      sigma_hit: 0.2
      tf_broadcast: true
      transform_tolerance: 1.0

      update_min_d: 0.25
      use_sim_time: true
      z_hit: 0.5

/tb3:
  amcl:
    ros__parameters:
      alpha1: 0.01
      alpha2: 0.01
      alpha3: 0.01
      alpha4: 0.01
      alpha5: 0.01
      base_frame_id: base_footprint
      beam_skip_distance: 0.5
      beam_skip_error_threshold: 0.9
      beam_skip_threshold: 0.3
      do_beamskip: false
      global_frame_id: map
      initial_pose:
        x: 6.0
        y: -1.5
        yaw: 0.0
        z: 0.01
      lambda_short: 0.1
      laser_likelihood_max_dist: 2.0
      laser_max_range: 100.0
      laser_min_range: -1.0
      laser_model_type: likelihood_field
      map_topic: /tb3/map
      max_beams: 60
      max_particles: 2000
      min_particles: 500
      odom_frame_id: odom
      pf_err: 0.05
      pf_z: 0.99
      recovery_alpha_fast: 0.0
      recovery_alpha_slow: 0.0
      resample_interval: 1
      robot_model_type: nav2_amcl::DifferentialMotionModel
      save_pose_rate: 0.5
      scan_topic: /tb3/scan
      set_initial_pose: true
      sigma_hit: 0.2
      tf_broadcast: true
      transform_tolerance: 1.0
      update_min_a: 0.2
      update_min_d: 0.25
      use_sim_time: true
      z_hit: 0.5
      z_max: 0.05
      z_rand: 0.5
      z_short: 0.05
  amcl_map_client:
    ros__parameters:
      use_sim_time: true
  amcl_rclcpp_node:
    ros__parameters:
      use_sim_time: true
  behavior_server:
    ros__parameters:
      max_rotational_vel: 0.3
      min_rotational_vel: 0.15
      rotational_acc_lim: 1.0
      use_sim_time: true
  bt_navigator:

      bt_loop_duration: 100
      default_server_timeout: 20
      global_frame: map
      navigate_through_poses:
        plugin: nav2_bt_navigator/NavigateThroughPosesNavigator
      navigate_to_pose:

      navigators:
      - navigate_to_pose

      - nav2_speed_controller_bt_node
      - nav2_truncate_path_action_bt_node
      - nav2_truncate_path_local_action_bt_node
      - nav2_goal_updater_node_bt_node
      - nav2_recovery_node_bt_node
      - nav2_pipeline_sequence_bt_node
      - nav2_round_robin_node_bt_node
      - nav2_transform_available_condition_bt_node
      - nav2_time_expired_condition_bt_node
      - nav2_path_expiring_timer_condition
      - nav2_distance_traveled_condition_bt_node
      - nav2_single_trigger_bt_node
      - nav2_goal_updated_controller_bt_node
      - nav2_is_battery_low_condition_bt_node
      - nav2_navigate_through_poses_action_bt_node
      - nav2_navigate_to_pose_action_bt_node
      - nav2_remove_passed_goals_action_bt_node

      - nav2_is_battery_charging_condition_bt_node
      robot_base_frame: base_footprint
      use_sim_time: true
      wait_for_service_timeout: 1000

    ros__parameters:
      use_sim_time: true

    ros__parameters:
      FollowPath:
        BaseObstacle.scale: 0.02
        GoalAlign.forward_point_distance: 0.1
        GoalAlign.scale: 24.0
        GoalDist.scale: 24.0
        PathAlign.forward_point_distance: 0.1
        PathAlign.scale: 32.0
        PathDist.scale: 32.0

        RotateToGoal.scale: 32.0

        acc_lim_y: 0.0
        angular_disengage_threshold: 0.5
        angular_dist_threshold: 0.5
        angular_granularity: 0.025

  amcl:
    ros__parameters:
      alpha1: 0.01
      alpha2: 0.01
      alpha3: 0.01

      alpha5: 0.01

      recovery_alpha_slow: 0.0

      scan_topic: /tb1/scan
      set_initial_pose: true
      sigma_hit: 0.2
      tf_broadcast: true

normal_smoother_parameter_files.raw:
/tb2:
  amcl:
    ros__parameters:
      alpha1: 0.01
      alpha2: 0.01
      alpha3: 0.01
      alpha4: 0.01
      alpha5: 0.01
      base_frame_id: base_footprint
      beam_skip_distance: 0.5
      beam_skip_error_threshold: 0.9
      beam_skip_threshold: 0.3
      do_beamskip: false
      global_frame_id: map
      initial_pose:
        x: -4.5
        y: 4.0
        yaw: 0.0
        z: 0.01
      lambda_short: 0.1
      laser_likelihood_max_dist: 2.0
      laser_max_range: 100.0
      laser_min_range: -1.0
      laser_model_type: likelihood_field
      map_topic: /tb2/map
      max_beams: 60
      max_particles: 2000
      min_particles: 500
      odom_frame_id: odom
      pf_err: 0.05
      pf_z: 0.99
      recovery_alpha_fast: 0.0
      recovery_alpha_slow: 0.0
      resample_interval: 1
      robot_model_type: nav2_amcl::DifferentialMotionModel
      save_pose_rate: 0.5
      scan_topic: /tb2/scan
      set_initial_pose: true
      sigma_hit: 0.2
      tf_broadcast: true
      transform_tolerance: 1.0
      update_min_a: 0.2
      update_min_d: 0.25
      use_sim_time: true
      z_hit: 0.5
      z_max: 0.05
      z_rand: 0.5
      z_short: 0.05
  amcl_map_client:
    ros__parameters:
      use_sim_time: true
  amcl_rclcpp_node:
    ros__parameters:
      use_sim_time: true
  behavior_server:
    ros__parameters:
      max_rotational_vel: 0.3
      min_rotational_vel: 0.15
      rotational_acc_lim: 1.0
      use_sim_time: true
  bt_navigator:
    ros__parameters:
      bt_loop_duration: 100
      default_server_timeout: 20
      global_frame: map
      navigate_through_poses:
        plugin: nav2_bt_navigator/NavigateThroughPosesNavigator
      navigate_to_pose:
        plugin: nav2_bt_navigator/NavigateToPoseNavigator
      navigators:
      - navigate_to_pose
      - navigate_through_poses
      odom_topic: /tb2/odom
      plugin_lib_names:
      - nav2_compute_path_to_pose_action_bt_node
      - nav2_compute_path_through_poses_action_bt_node
      - nav2_smooth_path_action_bt_node
      - nav2_follow_path_action_bt_node
      - nav2_spin_action_bt_node
      - nav2_wait_action_bt_node
      - nav2_assisted_teleop_action_bt_node
      - nav2_back_up_action_bt_node
      - nav2_drive_on_heading_bt_node
      - nav2_clear_costmap_service_bt_node
      - nav2_is_stuck_condition_bt_node
      - nav2_goal_reached_condition_bt_node
      - nav2_goal_updated_condition_bt_node
      - nav2_globally_updated_goal_condition_bt_node
      - nav2_is_path_valid_condition_bt_node
      - nav2_initial_pose_received_condition_bt_node
      - nav2_reinitialize_global_localization_service_bt_node
      - nav2_rate_controller_bt_node
      - nav2_distance_controller_bt_node
      - nav2_speed_controller_bt_node
      - nav2_truncate_path_action_bt_node
      - nav2_truncate_path_local_action_bt_node
      - nav2_goal_updater_node_bt_node
      - nav2_recovery_node_bt_node
      - nav2_pipeline_sequence_bt_node
      - nav2_round_robin_node_bt_node
      - nav2_transform_available_condition_bt_node
      - nav2_time_expired_condition_bt_node
      - nav2_path_expiring_timer_condition
      - nav2_distance_traveled_condition_bt_node
      - nav2_single_trigger_bt_node
      - nav2_goal_updated_controller_bt_node
      - nav2_is_battery_low_condition_bt_node
      - nav2_navigate_through_poses_action_bt_node
      - nav2_navigate_to_pose_action_bt_node
      - nav2_remove_passed_goals_action_bt_node
      - nav2_planner_selector_bt_node
      - nav2_controller_selector_bt_node
      - nav2_goal_checker_selector_bt_node
      - nav2_controller_cancel_bt_node
      - nav2_path_longer_on_approach_bt_node
      - nav2_wait_cancel_bt_node
      - nav2_spin_cancel_bt_node
      - nav2_back_up_cancel_bt_node
      - nav2_assisted_teleop_cancel_bt_node
      - nav2_drive_on_heading_cancel_bt_node
      - nav2_is_battery_charging_condition_bt_node
      robot_base_frame: base_footprint
      use_sim_time: true
      wait_for_service_timeout: 1000
  bt_navigator_rclcpp_node:
    ros__parameters:
      use_sim_time: true
  controller_server:
    ros__parameters:
      FollowPath:
        BaseObstacle.scale: 0.02
        GoalAlign.forward_point_distance: 0.1
        GoalAlign.scale: 24.0
        GoalDist.scale: 24.0
        PathAlign.forward_point_distance: 0.1
        PathAlign.scale: 32.0
        PathDist.scale: 32.0
        RotateToGoal.lookahead_time: -1.0
        RotateToGoal.scale: 32.0
        RotateToGoal.slowing_factor: 5.0
        acc_lim_theta: 1.0
        acc_lim_x: 0.5
        acc_lim_y: 0.0
        angular_disengage_threshold: 0.5
        angular_dist_threshold: 0.5
        angular_granularity: 0.025
        closed_loop: true
        critics:
        - RotateToGoal
        - Oscillation
        - BaseObstacle
        - GoalAlign
        - PathAlign
        - PathDist
        - GoalDist
        debug_trajectory_details: false
        decel_lim_theta: -3.2
        decel_lim_x: -0.5
        decel_lim_y: 0.0
        forward_sampling_distance: 0.3
        linear_granularity: 0.05
        max_angular_accel: 1.0
        max_speed_xy: 0.2
        max_vel_theta: 0.3
        max_vel_x: 0.2
        max_vel_y: 0.0
        min_speed_theta: 0.0
        min_speed_xy: 0.0
        min_vel_x: 0.0
        min_vel_y: 0.0
        plugin: nav2_rotation_shim_controller::RotationShimController
        primary_controller: dwb_core::DWBLocalPlanner
        rotate_to_goal_heading: false
        rotate_to_heading_angular_vel: 0.3
        short_circuit_trajectory_evaluation: true
        sim_time: 1.2
        simulate_ahead_time: 1.0
        stateful: true
        trans_stopped_velocity: 0.25
        transform_tolerance: 0.2
        vtheta_samples: 20
        vx_samples: 20
        vy_samples: 5
        xy_goal_tolerance: 0.1
      controller_frequency: 10.0

normal_smoother_parameter_files.raw:
/tb3:
  amcl:
    ros__parameters:
      alpha1: 0.01
      alpha2: 0.01
      alpha3: 0.01
      alpha4: 0.01
      alpha5: 0.01
      base_frame_id: base_footprint
      beam_skip_distance: 0.5
      beam_skip_error_threshold: 0.9
      beam_skip_threshold: 0.3
      do_beamskip: false
      global_frame_id: map
      initial_pose:
        x: 6.0
        y: -1.5
        yaw: 0.0
        z: 0.01
      lambda_short: 0.1
      laser_likelihood_max_dist: 2.0
      laser_max_range: 100.0
      laser_min_range: -1.0
      laser_model_type: likelihood_field
      map_topic: /tb3/map
      max_beams: 60
      max_particles: 2000
      min_particles: 500
      odom_frame_id: odom
      pf_err: 0.05
      pf_z: 0.99
      recovery_alpha_fast: 0.0
      recovery_alpha_slow: 0.0
      resample_interval: 1
      robot_model_type: nav2_amcl::DifferentialMotionModel
      save_pose_rate: 0.5
      scan_topic: /tb3/scan
      set_initial_pose: true
      sigma_hit: 0.2
      tf_broadcast: true
      transform_tolerance: 1.0
      update_min_a: 0.2
      update_min_d: 0.25
      use_sim_time: true
      z_hit: 0.5
      z_max: 0.05
      z_rand: 0.5
      z_short: 0.05
  amcl_map_client:
    ros__parameters:
      use_sim_time: true
  amcl_rclcpp_node:
    ros__parameters:
      use_sim_time: true
  behavior_server:
    ros__parameters:
      max_rotational_vel: 0.3
      min_rotational_vel: 0.15
      rotational_acc_lim: 1.0
      use_sim_time: true
  bt_navigator:
    ros__parameters:
      bt_loop_duration: 100
      default_server_timeout: 20
      global_frame: map
      navigate_through_poses:
        plugin: nav2_bt_navigator/NavigateThroughPosesNavigator
      navigate_to_pose:
        plugin: nav2_bt_navigator/NavigateToPoseNavigator
      navigators:
      - navigate_to_pose
      - navigate_through_poses
      odom_topic: /tb3/odom
      plugin_lib_names:
      - nav2_compute_path_to_pose_action_bt_node
      - nav2_compute_path_through_poses_action_bt_node
      - nav2_smooth_path_action_bt_node
      - nav2_follow_path_action_bt_node
      - nav2_spin_action_bt_node
      - nav2_wait_action_bt_node
      - nav2_assisted_teleop_action_bt_node
      - nav2_back_up_action_bt_node
      - nav2_drive_on_heading_bt_node
      - nav2_clear_costmap_service_bt_node
      - nav2_is_stuck_condition_bt_node
      - nav2_goal_reached_condition_bt_node
      - nav2_goal_updated_condition_bt_node
      - nav2_globally_updated_goal_condition_bt_node
      - nav2_is_path_valid_condition_bt_node
      - nav2_initial_pose_received_condition_bt_node
      - nav2_reinitialize_global_localization_service_bt_node
      - nav2_rate_controller_bt_node
      - nav2_distance_controller_bt_node
      - nav2_speed_controller_bt_node
      - nav2_truncate_path_action_bt_node
      - nav2_truncate_path_local_action_bt_node
      - nav2_goal_updater_node_bt_node
      - nav2_recovery_node_bt_node
      - nav2_pipeline_sequence_bt_node
      - nav2_round_robin_node_bt_node
      - nav2_transform_available_condition_bt_node
      - nav2_time_expired_condition_bt_node
      - nav2_path_expiring_timer_condition
      - nav2_distance_traveled_condition_bt_node
      - nav2_single_trigger_bt_node
      - nav2_goal_updated_controller_bt_node
      - nav2_is_battery_low_condition_bt_node
      - nav2_navigate_through_poses_action_bt_node
      - nav2_navigate_to_pose_action_bt_node
      - nav2_remove_passed_goals_action_bt_node
      - nav2_planner_selector_bt_node
      - nav2_controller_selector_bt_node
      - nav2_goal_checker_selector_bt_node
      - nav2_controller_cancel_bt_node
      - nav2_path_longer_on_approach_bt_node
      - nav2_wait_cancel_bt_node
      - nav2_spin_cancel_bt_node
      - nav2_back_up_cancel_bt_node
      - nav2_assisted_teleop_cancel_bt_node
      - nav2_drive_on_heading_cancel_bt_node
      - nav2_is_battery_charging_condition_bt_node
      robot_base_frame: base_footprint
      use_sim_time: true
      wait_for_service_timeout: 1000
  bt_navigator_rclcpp_node:
    ros__parameters:
      use_sim_time: true
  controller_server:
    ros__parameters:
      FollowPath:
        BaseObstacle.scale: 0.02
        GoalAlign.forward_point_distance: 0.1
        GoalAlign.scale: 24.0
        GoalDist.scale: 24.0
        PathAlign.forward_point_distance: 0.1
        PathAlign.scale: 32.0
        PathDist.scale: 32.0
        RotateToGoal.lookahead_time: -1.0
        RotateToGoal.scale: 32.0
        RotateToGoal.slowing_factor: 5.0
        acc_lim_theta: 1.0
        acc_lim_x: 0.5
        acc_lim_y: 0.0
        angular_disengage_threshold: 0.5
        angular_dist_threshold: 0.5
        angular_granularity: 0.025
        closed_loop: true
        critics:
        - RotateToGoal
        - Oscillation
        - BaseObstacle
        - GoalAlign
        - PathAlign
        - PathDist
        - GoalDist
        debug_trajectory_details: false
        decel_lim_theta: -3.2
        decel_lim_x: -0.5
        decel_lim_y: 0.0
        forward_sampling_distance: 0.3
        linear_granularity: 0.05
        max_angular_accel: 1.0
        max_speed_xy: 0.2
        max_vel_theta: 0.3
        max_vel_x: 0.2
        max_vel_y: 0.0
        min_speed_theta: 0.0
        min_speed_xy: 0.0
        min_vel_x: 0.0
        min_vel_y: 0.0
        plugin: nav2_rotation_shim_controller::RotationShimController
        primary_controller: dwb_core::DWBLocalPlanner

normal_smoother_parameter_files.raw:
/tb1:
  amcl:
    ros__parameters:
      alpha1: 0.01
      alpha2: 0.01
      alpha3: 0.01
      alpha4: 0.01
      alpha5: 0.01
      base_frame_id: base_footprint
      beam_skip_distance: 0.5
      beam_skip_error_threshold: 0.9
      beam_skip_threshold: 0.3
      do_beamskip: false
      global_frame_id: map
      initial_pose:
        x: 5.0
        y: 4.0
        yaw: 0.0
        z: 0.01
      lambda_short: 0.1
      laser_likelihood_max_dist: 2.0
      laser_max_range: 100.0
      laser_min_range: -1.0
      laser_model_type: likelihood_field
      map_topic: /tb1/map
      max_beams: 60
      max_particles: 2000
      min_particles: 500
      odom_frame_id: odom
      pf_err: 0.05
      pf_z: 0.99
      recovery_alpha_fast: 0.0
      recovery_alpha_slow: 0.0
      resample_interval: 1
      robot_model_type: nav2_amcl::DifferentialMotionModel
      save_pose_rate: 0.5
      scan_topic: /tb1/scan
      set_initial_pose: true
      sigma_hit: 0.2
      tf_broadcast: true
      transform_tolerance: 1.0
      update_min_a: 0.2
      update_min_d: 0.25
      use_sim_time: true
      z_hit: 0.5
      z_max: 0.05
      z_rand: 0.5
      z_short: 0.05
  amcl_map_client:
    ros__parameters:
      use_sim_time: true
  amcl_rclcpp_node:
    ros__parameters:
      use_sim_time: true
  behavior_server:
    ros__parameters:
      max_rotational_vel: 0.3
      min_rotational_vel: 0.15
      rotational_acc_lim: 1.0
      use_sim_time: true
  bt_navigator:
    ros__parameters:
      bt_loop_duration: 100
      default_server_timeout: 20
      global_frame: map
      navigate_through_poses:
        plugin: nav2_bt_navigator/NavigateThroughPosesNavigator
      navigate_to_pose:
        plugin: nav2_bt_navigator/NavigateToPoseNavigator
      navigators:
      - navigate_to_pose
      - navigate_through_poses
      odom_topic: /tb1/odom
      plugin_lib_names:

/tb3:
  amcl:
    ros__parameters:
      alpha1: 0.01
      alpha2: 0.01
      alpha3: 0.01
      alpha4: 0.01
      alpha5: 0.01
      base_frame_id: base_footprint
      beam_skip_distance: 0.5
      beam_skip_error_threshold: 0.9
      beam_skip_threshold: 0.3
      do_beamskip: false
      global_frame_id: map
      initial_pose:
        x: 6.0
        y: -1.5
        yaw: 0.0
        z: 0.01
      lambda_short: 0.1
      laser_likelihood_max_dist: 2.0
      laser_max_range: 100.0
      laser_min_range: -1.0
      laser_model_type: likelihood_field
      map_topic: /tb3/map
      max_beams: 60
      max_particles: 2000
      min_particles: 500
      odom_frame_id: odom
      pf_err: 0.05
      pf_z: 0.99
      recovery_alpha_fast: 0.0
      recovery_alpha_slow: 0.0
      resample_interval: 1
      robot_model_type: nav2_amcl::DifferentialMotionModel
      save_pose_rate: 0.5
      scan_topic: /tb3/scan
      set_initial_pose: true
      sigma_hit: 0.2
      tf_broadcast: true
      transform_tolerance: 1.0
      update_min_a: 0.2
      update_min_d: 0.25
      use_sim_time: true
      z_hit: 0.5
      z_max: 0.05
      z_rand: 0.5
      z_short: 0.05
  amcl_map_client:
    ros__parameters:
      use_sim_time: true
  amcl_rclcpp_node:
    ros__parameters:
      use_sim_time: true
  behavior_server:
    ros__parameters:
      max_rotational_vel: 0.3
      min_rotational_vel: 0.15
      rotational_acc_lim: 1.0
      use_sim_time: true
  bt_navigator:

      bt_loop_duration: 100
      default_server_timeout: 20
      global_frame: map
      navigate_through_poses:
        plugin: nav2_bt_navigator/NavigateThroughPosesNavigator
      navigate_to_pose:
        plugin: nav2_bt_navigator/NavigateToPoseNavigator
      navigators:
      - navigate_to_pose

      - nav2_distance_controller_bt_node
      - nav2_speed_controller_bt_node
      - nav2_truncate_path_action_bt_node
      - nav2_truncate_path_local_action_bt_node
      - nav2_goal_updater_node_bt_node
      - nav2_recovery_node_bt_node
      - nav2_pipeline_sequence_bt_node
      - nav2_round_robin_node_bt_node
      - nav2_transform_available_condition_bt_node
      - nav2_time_expired_condition_bt_node
      - nav2_path_expiring_timer_condition
      - nav2_distance_traveled_condition_bt_node
      - nav2_single_trigger_bt_node
      - nav2_goal_updated_controller_bt_node
      - nav2_is_battery_low_condition_bt_node
      - nav2_navigate_through_poses_action_bt_node
      - nav2_navigate_to_pose_action_bt_node
      - nav2_remove_passed_goals_action_bt_node

      - nav2_controller_selector_bt_node

      - nav2_drive_on_heading_cancel_bt_node
      - nav2_is_battery_charging_condition_bt_node
      robot_base_frame: base_footprint
      use_sim_time: true
      wait_for_service_timeout: 1000
  bt_navigator_rclcpp_node:
    ros__parameters:
      use_sim_time: true

    ros__parameters:
      FollowPath:
        BaseObstacle.scale: 0.02
        GoalAlign.forward_point_distance: 0.1
        GoalAlign.scale: 24.0
        GoalDist.scale: 24.0
        PathAlign.forward_point_distance: 0.1
        PathAlign.scale: 32.0
        PathDist.scale: 32.0

        RotateToGoal.scale: 32.0
        RotateToGoal.slowing_factor: 5.0
        acc_lim_theta: 1.0
        acc_lim_x: 0.5
        acc_lim_y: 0.0
        angular_disengage_threshold: 0.5
        angular_dist_threshold: 0.5
        angular_granularity: 0.025
        closed_loop: true
        critics:

        - GoalAlign

        - PathDist

        forward_sampling_distance: 0.3
        linear_granularity: 0.05

        max_speed_xy: 0.2

        max_vel_x: 0.2
        max_vel_y: 0.0
        min_speed_theta: 0.0
